urn:eigenius:core:description: One-compartment pharmacokinetic clearance model for the EIG_0042 inhibitor: `dC/dt = -k_elim * C`. Initial dose 100 nM, elimination rate 0.5 / hour, integrated over 1 hour. Mirrors the ODE probe in api-survey.md (the simplest decay shape) so the example doubles as a regression check.

Tsit5 solution to the EIG_0042 PK decay problem. Closed-form check: u(1) = 100 * exp(-0.5) ≈ 60.6531. AutoOnLoad re-solves and confirms the trajectory hash.

NB: `trajectory_hash` is a placeholder in this example — populated by the institution at extract time on a real run. The `trajectory_t` and `trajectory_u` here are illustrative (5 saved points for readability); the institution may save more or fewer points depending on `saveat` configuration.
